description: Share of TSR records exhibiting at least one accuracy anomaly (negative notional, zero notional, negative valuation, placeholder maturity). Multi-field rollup of EMIR.ACC.* granular checks.
MSR not provided
TSR + MSR both required for cross-table indicator
MSR not provided
confirmation_timestamp not mapped or never observed — DQI_CONF_MISSING skipped
Share of TSR records whose UTI appears in more than one row in the snapshot. Indicator-level rollup of EMIR.UNI.DUPLICATE_UTI + EMIR.TST.DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_UTI granular checks.
Share of TAR records with no entity_responsible_for_reporting (ERR) LEI.

Share of reconciliation records with at least one mismatched matching-criterion (from auth.091 MtchgCrit). Per-criterion breakdowns: DQI_NOTIONAL_INCONSISTENT + DQI_MARGIN_INCONSISTENT_PRE/POST_HAIRCUT.
Share of TSR records with at least one missing/empty counterparty LEI (reporting or other). Format validation (ISO 17442 check digit) remains in the EMIR.VLD.LEI_FORMAT_* granular checks.

Share of paired auth.091 records where the IM/VM posted-or-received POST-haircut amount mismatched between counterparties. Token set defaults from canonical ESMA EMIR REFIT auth.091 ValtnMtchgCrit leaf names.

Share of paired auth.091 records where the IM/VM posted-or-received PRE-haircut amount mismatched between counterparties. Token set defaults from canonical ESMA EMIR REFIT auth.091 ValtnMtchgCrit leaf names.
Share of TAR records with no counterparty nature (FC/NFC/NFC+) classifier. Without it the firm cannot apply the right Art.11 clearing threshold / IM cadence / confirmation deadlines.

Share of paired auth.091 records where the notional-amount criterion mismatched between counterparties. Token set defaults from canonical ESMA EMIR REFIT auth.091 MtchgCrit leaf names ; configurable override via dqi.* YAML block (v0.17+).

Share of TR-side trade reports that are NOT paired with a counterparty submission, averaged across counterparties (from auth.091 reconciliation statistics). Lower = better. v0.16 ships one combined pairing rate per counterparty pair ; TCTN/POSI stratum split = v0.17+.

Share of EMIR auth.090 CollPosSet/CcyCollPosSet records that report no collateral amount (Mtrcs/Ttl/PstdMrgnOrColl/.../Amt absent). PosSet/CcyPosSet kinds excluded — they don't carry collateral metrics.
Share of EMIR auth.090 PosSet/CcyPosSet records that report no mark-to-market value (Mtrcs/Ttl/Buyr/PostvVal absent). CollPosSet kinds excluded.

Share of EMIR auth.090 PosSet/CcyPosSet records that report no notional amount (Mtrcs/Ttl/Buyr/Ntnl/Amt absent). CollPosSet/CcyCollPosSet records are excluded — they don't carry the notional metric at the XSD level.

Share of EMIR auth.090 PosSet/CcyPosSet records that report a strictly-negative notional amount. Negative aggregate notional has no regulatory meaning at the position-set level — it's a structural defect or sign error.

Share of paired trades that do NOT reconcile across counterparties (from auth.091). Lower = better. Per-criterion breakdowns are surfaced by DQI_NOTIONAL_INCONSISTENT and DQI_MARGIN_INCONSISTENT_PRE/POST_HAIRCUT.
reconciliation_status not mapped or never observed — DQI_REC_STATUS_UNPAIRED skipped
Share of feedback records that are TR rejections. Denominator is total feedback rows (proxy for total submissions).
Distinct UTIs rejected by the TR ≥ 2 times within the feedback batch — chronic rejection candidates.
Share of TAR records with no corporate_sector classifier.
TAR records whose reporting_timestamp lags execution_timestamp by more than the configured max_reporting_delay_hours.
Share of per-trade reconciliation records with pairing_status=UNPAIRED (from auth.091 per-tx detail). Complementary to DQI_PAIRING_RATE which counts at the counterparty level.
Outstanding TSR records with no valuation amount (or a zero valuation, treated as not reported).
TSR records whose valuation timestamp is older than the configured threshold (TARGET2 business days since v0.16, was calendar-day proxy in v0.15).
MSR not provided
